title: VER13 Evidence Kinds v1
description: Maps each evidence kind named by a catalogue entry's discharge.evidence_kinds to the manifest that can hold it and the evidence-id patterns of that kind (VER13 section 5.1). Structural contract only; closure with the catalogue (every named kind defined, every defined kind named) and pattern disjointness are enforced by code/scripts/assumption_catalogue.py and ca-assurance-report.

manifest.description: planned: no manifest produces this kind yet, so its evidence cannot discharge anything.

patterns.description: '/'-separated segments; '*' matches exactly one non-empty segment; the first segment is a literal namespace (warrant for test/proof, bench for bench, anything else for planned).

per_run.description: Per-run evidence is about one pinned build and needs the pinned tuple (rule AC-9).
